summary: Thumbnails that open a full-screen viewer: swipe or the arrow keys move between pictures, and a double click, a pinch or the wheel zooms.

props.name: images
props.description: The pictures, as a grid of thumbnails that each open the viewer.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius of the thumbnails and the picture. Inherits the nearest `Shape`.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it on every focusable part of the component, which is more than `className` reaches. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.

props.name: container
props.description: Where the viewer is rendered. Defaults to `document.body`; pass an element to portal somewhere else, such as inside a frame.
